newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo corn futures market closes mixed.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo corn futures market closes mixed.

text.p: Tokyo corn futures closed mixed on Tuesday as local investors hesitated to sell following Monday's price losses, traders said.
The benchmark January 1998 contract was up 80 yen at 15,240 yen per tonne at the closing. The day's volume was 68,344 lots.
On Monday, yen-based Tokyo corn futures fell sharply due to losses on the Chicago market on Friday and the stronger yen against the dollar.
"Local investors hesitated to sell further today, and some months recovered on light technical buying," a brokerage trader said. Open interest as of February 3 was 570,829 lots.
The spot March contract on the CBOT Project A trading system was being traded at $2.70 per bushel at 0737 GMT, up from $2.69-1/2 at Monday's close.
The spot March of the CBOT soybean futures on the overnight trading system was at $7.38 at 0738 GMT, up from $7.36-3/4 at Monday's close.
